{"consolidated_memory":"SPURIOUS 429 ERRORS IN API GATEWAY RATE LIMITER — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: api/gateway/rate_limit.go (api gateway side)
Stack: Go
Test coverage: api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go
Common signal: throttle counters far above the configured ceiling
Common repro method: replay the saved burst fixture

INCIDENT 1: [2026-06-21] — CONNECTION POOL EXHAUSTION
- Specific trigger: occurred only when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #2126 on branch fix/spurious-429-1
- Result: memory usage settled at 509 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB

INCIDENT 2: [2026-08-25] — RACE CONDITION IN LAZY INITIALIZATION
- Specific trigger: occurred only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: a race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #4898 on branch fix/spurious-429-2
- Result: 64 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Context note: same corner of api/gateway/rate_limit.go as the earlier spurious 429 work, so context carried over from incident 1"}
